lines.zh: 长脖子一摆，我迈开四条腿。
lines.en: My long neck sways as I set off on four legs.

lines.zh: 我一步踏下去，地面发闷响。
lines.en: Every step I take makes the ground thud.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖在身后，扫过灌木。
lines.en: My tail drags behind, sweeping the shrubs.

lines.zh: 我沿着林缘走，够高处的叶。
lines.en: I walk the forest edge to reach the high leaves.

lines.zh: 我这身量，走路得慢慢来。
lines.en: A body this size has to walk slowly.
My neck reaches into the canopy.
I lower my head to watch the ground; my neck is too long.

lines.zh: 同伴在前，我跟着它的尾巴。
lines.en: A herd-mate leads; I follow his tail.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根枯枝，声音很脆。
lines.en: A dry branch snaps under me, sharp and loud.
At the water's edge I pause first.

lines.zh: 我的脚印比你的脚大十倍。
lines.en: My footprint is ten times your foot.
The high canopy is waiting for me.
I walk around the boulder rather than duck.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脖子都往前探。
lines.en: With every step my neck reaches a little further.

lines.zh: 我站着，风从长颈中间穿过。
lines.en: I stand still while the wind passes along my long neck.
I chew the leaves and swallow slowly.

lines.zh: 尾巴末端轻轻抽了一下空气。
lines.en: The tip of my tail flicks the air once.
I'm listening to the sounds of the woods.
I've stood so long my shadow has grown.

lines.zh: 有一群小东西在我脚边跑。
lines.en: Something small is running past my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看看天要不要下雨。
lines.en: I raise my head to see if rain is coming.

lines.zh: 脊椎从上到下，一节一节动。
lines.en: My spine moves joint by joint from top to bottom.
I swallow, and my gut feels heavy.

lines.zh: 这片林子的叶子不算多。
lines.en: This forest doesn't have many leaves.
My long neck droops as I doze.

lines.zh: 远处有食肉恐龙的味道。
lines.en: There's the smell of a predator far off.

lines.zh: 我不动，它们就看不清我。
lines.en: If I stay still, they can't make me out.
One mouthful of leaves, chewed for a long while.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我低头，正好对上。
lines.en: You look up, I look down, and we meet.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我看不全你。
lines.en: You're too close; I can't see all of you.

lines.zh: 我的脖子有你十个人那么高。
lines.en: My neck stands ten of you tall.
My neck reaches the treetops.
I bend my neck slowly down toward you.
Will you touch me, or run?

lines.zh: 我眼里你很小，但很清楚。
lines.en: You're small in my eyes, but clear.

lines.zh: 我打量你，像打量一丛草。
lines.en: I size you up like a clump of grass.
Don't stand under me; I'll step on you.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气吹动了你的头发。
lines.en: My breath stirs your hair.
You stepped back, and now I'm curious.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛，长在很高的地方。
lines.en: My eyes sit very high up.
Thick hide still hurts.
Who's biting me down there?
I whip my tail to shake the pain off.
That knocked me off my line.
My legs tremble, but they don't buckle.
Blood runs down my long neck.
I turn to find whoever did that.
The pain takes my breath away.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一甩，够你飞出去。
lines.en: One swing of my tail sends you flying.
I've noted where that came from.
Leaves. Fresh leaves.
The bunch in your hand is a tender green.
I lower my head to reach your hand.
That much grass won't fill a tooth gap.
Hold it higher; my neck is long.

lines.zh: 我闻到叶子的汁水味了。
lines.en: I can smell the sap in those leaves.
You're feeding me? I won't be polite.
One step brings me right in front of you.
Don't pull it back; I'm not done.

lines.zh: 我伸出舌头，卷住那丛草。
lines.en: I reach out my tongue and curl it around the grass.
I bump into you like a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 你被我的腿推开了半步。
lines.en: My leg nudges you half a step aside.

lines.zh: 对不起，我没看见这么小的东西。
lines.en: Sorry, I didn't see something so small.
I quickly pull my foot back.
After that, you should stand further off.
Did my tail catch you?
The ground shook. That was me.
I turn to make way, and you don't move.
My hide is harder than your bones.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我停了步。
lines.en: We met with a bump and I stopped.
My herd-mate is just down the slope.

lines.zh: 我把脖子靠过去，碰了碰。
lines.en: I lean my neck over and touch hers.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴交叉，像一道栅栏。
lines.en: Our tails cross like a fence.

lines.zh: 这时候，整个群都会守着我们。
lines.en: At a time like this the whole herd stands guard.
I scrape a shallow pit in the soil.

lines.zh: 蛋会埋在这片暖土下面。
lines.en: The eggs will lie under this warm earth.

lines.zh: 它比我小一圈，脾气也温和。
lines.en: She's a size smaller, and gentler.

lines.zh: 我们并排站，脖子朝同一个方向。
lines.en: We stand side by side, necks pointing one way.

lines.zh: 等小的出来，群就更大了。
lines.en: When the little ones hatch, the herd grows.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，适合留下后代。
lines.en: This quiet place is good for leaving young behind.
I lower my head and take the clump of grass.
This mouthful goes down with the soil.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起树上的叶。
lines.en: I curl my tongue around the leaves on the branch.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的果子，我不挑。
lines.en: Fruit on the ground; I'm not picky.
I can carry off a whole branch in one bite.
I swallow, and it travels down slowly.
That much only takes the edge off.
I save the tender leaves for last.

lines.zh: 它们落下来，我正好张嘴。
lines.en: They fall, and my mouth is already open.
Finished. I lick my lips.
Something is moving behind that tree.
I raise my head and see it.

lines.zh: 一头食肉的，正看着我们。
lines.en: A meat-eater is watching us.
It picked the wrong herd.
I count my herd-mates. Three is enough.
I lower my neck, ready to butt.
The small one is behind me.
I fix on it and stop grazing.
I press the soil firm under my feet.

lines.zh: 它靠近一步，我也进一步。
lines.en: It takes a step closer; so do I.
My tail lifts first, as a warning.

lines.zh: 这个距离，它还来得及走。
lines.en: At this distance it can still walk away.
The whole herd has turned its heads.
I pick the one charging first.

lines.zh: 我的脚印一直压在它后面
lines.en: My prints keep landing right behind it.

lines.zh: 它想绕到我侧面，我看见了。
lines.en: It wants my flank — I saw it.

lines.zh: 我转过大半个身子挡住。
lines.en: I swing most of my body around to block it.
My tail stays pointed at it.
It backs off; I don't chase far.
I lower my long neck and aim at it.
A herd-mate closes in from the other side.
The leaves tremble when I breathe in.

lines.zh: 它试了两次，都没找到口子。
lines.en: It's tried twice and found no opening.
I am the wall.
The moment it lowers its head, I raise my tail.

lines.zh: 地上的影子把我们连成一片。
lines.en: Our shadows on the ground join into one.
It's beginning to give ground.
I don't roar; I speak with my body.
One more step and I swing my tail.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩出去，抽在它肋上。
lines.en: My tail whips out and cracks its ribs.

lines.zh: 我用前腿踏下去，地都震了。
lines.en: I stamp with a foreleg and the ground jumps.

lines.zh: 这一记尾鞭，抽得它踉跄。
lines.en: That tail-lash makes it stumble.

lines.zh: 我低头撞它，像撞一棵树。
lines.en: I butt it the way I'd fell a tree.

lines.zh: 它咬住我的后腿，我不退。
lines.en: It bites my hind leg; I don't step back.
I turn and lean my whole weight in.
My tail misses; the wind arrives first.
One kick of mine throws it aside.
My heel comes down on its back.
It's bleeding. I smell it.
Another lash and it gives way.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，扫倒草丛
lines.en: I swing my tail and flatten the brush.
I drive it off the forest's edge.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖抽在它耳后
lines.en: The tip of my tail flicks behind its ear.
My long neck comes out of the mist first.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的林子，比记忆里矮了。
lines.en: The Jurassic forest is shorter than I remember.

lines.zh: 第一脚踩下去，草伏了一片。
lines.en: My first step flattens a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够到最高的枝。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to the highest branch.

lines.zh: 我不认识这些树，但认得叶子。
lines.en: I don't know these trees, but I know leaves.

lines.zh: 远处有一声长鸣，不是我。
lines.en: A long call sounds far off, not mine.

lines.zh: 三只以上，我们就不逃了。
lines.en: Three or more, and we stop running.
There's room enough here to walk.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，赶走尘土。
lines.en: I flick my tail to shake off the dust.

lines.zh: 一头巨大的东西，站在你面前。
lines.en: Something enormous is standing before you.
I turn my head slowly and take in the land.

lines.zh: 草叶在我嘴边，我先吃一口。
lines.en: Grass at my lips; I take one bite first.

lines.zh: 我的脚印一路从雾里过来。
lines.en: My tracks lead in out of the mist.

lines.zh: 身上还带着旧日子的暖。
lines.en: The warmth of old days still clings to me.

lines.zh: 群里有三只，我们就回头。
lines.en: Three of us, and we turn around.

lines.zh: 林子里安静，只有我的脚步。
lines.en: The woods are quiet except for my steps.
When I lower my head, the sky comes down.

lines.zh: 这里会有水吗？我闻到湿。
lines.en: Is there water here? I smell damp.

lines.zh: 火苗窜上我的背，烫得我乱撞。
lines.en: Flame climbs my back and I lurch about.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，五脏都在震。
lines.en: I fell from a height; everything inside me shakes.

lines.zh: 水没过我的鼻孔，我仰起头。
lines.en: Water covers my nostrils and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我半个身子都麻了。
lines.en: A blast numbs half of me.
An arrow is stuck in my neck.

lines.zh: 腿被紫光绑住，我挣不动
lines.en: Purple light binds my leg, and I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 树顶的叶子都被吃光了。
lines.en: The leaves at the canopy are all eaten.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，皮都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; my hide prickles.

lines.zh: 我四条腿在虚空里乱蹬
lines.en: My four legs kick at nothing in the void.
